name: SniffleShop: BUFT
subtitle: Curated sideloading tools, emulators, utilities, and open-source iOS apps
description: SniffleShop: BUFT is an independently maintained, expanded SideStore/AltStore source with 84 distinct apps and 106 upstream IPA builds. Each app entry is being documented for practical use: what it does, how its main features fit together, what must be supplied or configured by the user, and important signing, JIT, iOS-version, account, or source limitations. The catalog spans sideloading managers, LiveContainer companions, developer and file utilities, emulators, local virtual machines and game runtimes, media clients, readers, and customization tools. IPA downloads remain hosted by their upstream projects; compatibility notes are not a guarantee that every app or feature works on every device.

apps.name: LiveContainer
apps.subtitle: Run sideloaded apps inside a container
apps.localizedDescription: LiveContainer launches iOS apps without installing each one as a separate signed app. It supports multiple guest apps, app management, multitasking features, tweaks, and JIT/JIT-less workflows. The standalone IPA listed here is the build intended to be installed through SideStore 0.6.2 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds storage management, multiple-LiveContainer launch priority, share-sheet app opening, StosDebug JIT support, multitasking improvements, and compatibility fixes.

apps.name: Feather
apps.subtitle: On-device signing and app management
apps.localizedDescription: Feather is a free, open-source on-device signing and sideloading manager for iPhone and iPad. Import and organize IPA files, add AltStore-compatible sources, inspect app metadata, choose signing options, configure supported tweak injection, and sign/install apps with certificates available to the device. It is designed to manage the sideloading workflow locally; app installation and refresh still depend on valid signing credentials and iOS signing limits.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds tweak options to default signing settings, identifier search in the library, and fixes file enumeration, credit links, and duplicate recommended repositories.

apps.name: StikDebug
apps.subtitle: On-device debugger and JIT enabler
apps.localizedDescription: StikDebug is an on-device developer utility for compatible sideloaded apps on iOS 17.4 and later. It helps establish the debugging/JIT workflow, launch target apps, inspect process and console output, run supported scripts, check signing or expiration information, and simulate device location for testing. JIT support depends on the iOS version, app entitlement/signing setup, and active debugging connection; it does not make every app compatible automatically.

versions.localizedDescription: Attempt to fix ServiceNotFound errors, add debugging.

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS with JIT
apps.localizedDescription: UTM is a QEMU-based virtual-machine manager for iPhone and iPad. Create and configure virtual machines, attach disk images and installation media, choose supported CPU architectures and hardware settings, and boot operating systems such as Linux or Windows from images you provide. This is the JIT-enabled, non-SE build, so supported guests can run substantially faster when JIT is available; performance and installability depend on the guest OS, device, memory limits, and iOS restrictions.

versions.localizedDescription: QEMU 10.0.2-based release with OS 26 design updates, App Intents, custom keyboard shortcuts, an improved VM wizard, and stability fixes. This is the non-jailbroken sideloading IPA.

apps.name: iSH
apps.subtitle: A local Linux shell for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: iSH provides a local Alpine Linux-style command-line environment on iPhone and iPad. Its terminal uses user-mode x86 emulation and Linux system-call translation rather than booting a full Linux kernel. Use its shell and package environment for command-line utilities, text processing, scripting, lightweight development, and working with files available to the app. It is not a general-purpose virtual machine, and CPU-intensive or Linux-kernel-dependent software may not work.

versions.localizedDescription: Latest stable GitHub release. Includes file-provider diagnostics fixes and the 1.3.x Linux-shell feature set. Newer automated prerelease builds exist upstream, but SniffleShop tracks the stable release here.

apps.name: Yattee
apps.subtitle: Privacy-focused video player
apps.localizedDescription: Yattee is an open-source privacy-focused video player for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. It can use Invidious, Piped, or a self-hosted Yattee Server for YouTube, and also supports PeerTube, local files, SMB, WebDAV, background audio, Picture in Picture, SponsorBlock, DeArrow, downloads, subscriptions, bookmarks, and iCloud sync.

versions.localizedDescription: Current official iOS beta build 270 of the Yattee 2.0 rewrite.

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Native torrent client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: iTorrent is an open-source native torrent client for iOS with Files integration, background downloading, Live Activities, Dynamic Island progress, a built-in VLC-based media player, sequential downloading, magnet links, WebDAV/web server support, RSS feeds, and external-drive support.

permissions.usageDescription: Needs network access to download and seed torrent data.
Used by the app to keep transfers active in the background.
Can be used as a more robust background-running method when enabled.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds the built-in VLC player, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, sequential/first-last piece priority, multi-file sharing, iOS 26 interface updates, and multiple stability fixes.

apps.name: Angel Aura Amethyst
apps.subtitle: Minecraft Java Edition launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Angel Aura Amethyst is the active successor to PojavLauncher for running Minecraft: Java Edition on iOS. It supports many Minecraft versions, mods, resource packs, compatible shaders, multiple instances, custom touch controls, controllers, keyboard and mouse, and Java Edition servers. JIT is required.

permissions.usageDescription: Used by compatible voice-chat mods when they request microphone access.
Used for network play, LAN discovery, and supported JIT/sideload integrations.

versions.localizedDescription: Current Amethyst test build published by the official AngelAuraMC source, commit 9212a18.

apps.name: Provenance
apps.subtitle: Multi-system retro emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Provenance is an open-source multi-system emulator for iOS and tvOS supporting dozens of classic systems, including Nintendo, Sega, PlayStation and handheld platforms. It includes controller support, save states, RetroAchievements, artwork and library management, and cloud-sync features.

permissions.usageDescription: Used to discover and connect to local network game servers for netplay.
Used when scanning QR codes for supported game-data import flows.

versions.localizedDescription: Stable 3.3.0 release with expanded iCloud/CloudKit sync, a redesigned tvOS interface, video filters and shaders, controller/core fixes, and broad stability improvements.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform frontend for emulation
apps.localizedDescription: RetroArch is an open-source frontend for emulators, game engines, and media players. The official iOS sideload build includes additional cores compared with marketplace builds and can use JIT/dynamic recompilation for supported cores when JIT is available.

versions.localizedDescription: Current stable Libretro iOS sideload build, published from RetroArch 1.22.2. This is the official buildbot IPA, not a third-party mirror.

apps.name: osu!
apps.subtitle: Free-to-win rhythm game
apps.localizedDescription: osu! lazer is the open-source modern client for the osu! rhythm-game ecosystem, packaged here as an iOS build for iPhone and iPad. Play beatmaps using supported touch and other input methods, browse and manage available beatmap content, and use the newer lazer client and account ecosystem. This is a community-platform game client, not a standalone collection of licensed songs; content availability and controls vary by build and device.

versions.localizedDescription: Official osu! lazer iOS build from the current stable GitHub release.

apps.name: Aidoku
apps.subtitle: Open-source manga reader
apps.localizedDescription: Aidoku is a free, open-source manga reader for iPhone and iPad. Add compatible external source extensions to discover and fetch series, organize a personal library, download chapters for offline reading, and customize reading direction, appearance, and other reader settings. It can also open local CBZ archives and connect supported tracking services. External sources are maintained separately and may change or stop working when their websites change.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aidoku needs FaceID permissions for user-defined settings
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to save pages in your photo library
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to connect to local Komga servers

versions.localizedDescription: Adds OCR dictionary support, a built-in Suwayomi source, webtoon auto-scroll, Cloudflare handling fixes, source stability controls, and performance improvements.

apps.name: NOOP
apps.subtitle: Read your own WHOOP strap, fully offline.
apps.localizedDescription: NOOP talks to a WHOOP 4.0 / 5.0 / MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth — no WHOOP app, no subscription, no cloud. Live heart rate, history sync, and NOOP's own Charge / Effort / Rest scores, all computed on-device and stored only on your iPhone. Independent and experimental; not affiliated with WHOOP. Source: https://github.com/ryanbr/noop

permissions.usageDescription: Connects directly to a compatible WHOOP strap.

apps.name: Nyora
apps.subtitle: Modern manga and comics reader
apps.localizedDescription: Nyora is an open-source manga and comics reader for iOS. It brings supported online sources and local reading into one library, allowing readers to browse series, organize titles, retrieve chapters, save supported content for offline use, and adjust the reading experience. Source availability and download behavior depend on the configured providers and the current app build.

versions.localizedDescription: Official Nyora 2.7.3 iOS release from the project GitHub.

apps.name: Stremio
apps.subtitle: Extensible media center
apps.localizedDescription: Stremio is a media center for movies, series, live TV, and web channels with an add-on system. This entry uses the plain iOS IPA published on Stremio's own CDN; some Apple-account integrations do not work when sideloaded.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds download Live Activities, storage management, subtitle Live Sync, playback fixes, and multiple download and iPad improvements.

apps.name: Sable
apps.subtitle: Modern Matrix client
apps.localizedDescription: Sable is an open-source Matrix messaging client for iOS. Connect a Matrix account and homeserver to send and receive messages, participate in rooms, share media, receive notifications, and use supported voice or video calling features. Encrypted conversations depend on Matrix encryption support and correct device/key setup; homeserver policies and notification configuration can affect the experience.

versions.localizedDescription: Official stable iOS build from Sable 1.21.0.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.subtitle: Fast, accurate PSP emulator
apps.localizedDescription: PPSSPP is an open-source emulator for Sony's PlayStation Portable (PSP). Import PSP game images you are entitled to use, configure graphics and per-game compatibility options, raise rendering resolution on capable devices, use save states and speed controls, connect supported controllers, and manage texture replacements or networking features where supported. It does not include commercial game files, and performance varies by game and device.

versions.localizedDescription: Official iOS IPA from the PPSSPP 1.20.4 release.

apps.name: Delta
apps.subtitle: Nintendo-focused multi-system emulator
apps.localizedDescription: Delta is an open-source emulator focused on classic Nintendo handheld and console systems. It organizes imported game files into a library, displays available artwork, offers configurable on-screen controller skins and supported physical-controller input, and provides save states, in-game saves, cheats, fast-forward, and save synchronization features. Supported systems and features depend on the current build; game files are not included.

versions.localizedDescription: Official Delta 1.6 sideload IPA with native iPad support, Handoff, updated melonDS, save-state export, and additional controller gestures.

apps.name: MAME4iOS
apps.subtitle: Arcade emulator with TAS-friendly tools
apps.localizedDescription: MAME4iOS is an iPhone and iPad port of MAME for emulating supported arcade machines. It loads compatible arcade ROM sets, provides configurable controls and emulator settings, and includes deterministic input recording/playback and single-step execution in this build. Those frame-by-frame tools are useful for testing repeatable inputs and tool-assisted-speedrun research, but compatibility depends on the exact ROM set and MAME core version. Game ROMs are not bundled.

versions.localizedDescription: Official 2022.5 iOS build using the MAME 0.250 core.

apps.name: Pocket8
apps.subtitle: Native PICO-8 emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Pocket8 is a native PICO-8 fantasy-console emulator for iPhone and iPad. Import and organize cartridge files in .p8 or .p8.png format, launch supported cartridges, play with touch controls or a compatible controller, and use the app's cartridge library and save-state features. It can run homebrew cartridges such as Celeste Classic and Celeste Classic 2; it is not a full desktop PICO-8 license or cartridge marketplace.

versions.localizedDescription: v1.6.2 hotfix from the official Pocket8 GitHub release.

apps.name: SideStore
apps.subtitle: AltStore fork - no AltServer required
apps.localizedDescription: SideStore is an open-source AltStore-derived sideloading manager that can refresh apps directly on the iPhone or iPad using a supported local pairing/WireGuard workflow, rather than requiring AltServer for every refresh. Add compatible sources, install signed IPA files, and manage app refreshes within Apple's signing limits. Initial setup still requires a computer-assisted pairing/signing step and a supported network/VPN configuration; compatibility can change between iOS releases.

versions.localizedDescription: AltStore fork with on-device refresh.

apps.name: UTM SE
apps.subtitle: UTM Slow Edition — no JIT required, App Store compliant
apps.localizedDescription: UTM SE (Slow Edition) is the JIT-free variant of UTM for running virtual machines on iPhone and iPad. It uses QEMU to boot supported operating-system images you supply and offers VM configuration and virtual disk/media management, but runs more slowly than the JIT-enabled UTM build because it cannot use JIT or the hypervisor acceleration path. Choose it when JIT setup is unavailable or undesirable; compatibility and speed depend on the guest OS and device.

versions.localizedDescription: Slow Edition - runs without JIT. Use this if you don't have StikDebug/JIT.

apps.name: Spotube
apps.subtitle: Open-source Spotify client — no premium needed (SwiftUI/Flutter)
apps.localizedDescription: Spotube is an open-source music-streaming frontend that combines Spotify's catalog and metadata with supported alternative audio providers such as YouTube Music or Piped. Browse and search music, view artist and album information, manage playlists and playback, and stream without requiring a Spotify Premium subscription. Provider availability, account requirements, regional access, and playback reliability can vary. This entry is the project's iOS IPA release, not an official Spotify application.

versions.localizedDescription: Open-source Spotify client with YouTube/Piped backend. No account needed.

apps.name: BHTwitter
apps.subtitle: Tweaked Twitter/X — ad block, download, premium unlock (tweaked)
apps.localizedDescription: BHTwitter is a modified Twitter/X client created by injecting a tweak into a compatible decrypted app build. Depending on the included tweak and upstream version, it adds controls such as blocking promoted posts, downloading supported media, hiding selected interface elements, and changing appearance. This is not an official X release; feature behavior can break when X changes its app or service. The listed bundle identifier may replace the standard app, so back up data and check compatibility before installing.

versions.localizedDescription: Tweaked Twitter with ad-block, media downloads and premium unlock.

apps.name: LBox
apps.subtitle: SwiftUI repo manager for LiveContainer (NEW 2025)
apps.localizedDescription: LBox is a native SwiftUI companion for LiveContainer. It lets you browse configured public IPA sources, search catalog entries, download compatible IPA packages, and hand supported apps to LiveContainer for import or launch without managing every file manually. It is intended to complement a working LiveContainer setup, not replace the container itself or the signing/refresh tool used to install it. Source contents and guest-app compatibility vary.

versions.localizedDescription: SwiftUI repository manager for LiveContainer — browse, download and launch IPAs.

apps.name: Apollo (Patched)
apps.subtitle: Reddit's Apollo — revived with custom API key (tweaked)
apps.localizedDescription: Apollo (Patched) is a modified build of the discontinued Apollo Reddit client. The patch restores API access by allowing the user to supply their own Reddit API client ID and secret in the app's settings; it does not provide Reddit credentials for you. The client retains Apollo's familiar browsing and account interface, but it relies on Reddit's current API policies and may break if the service changes. This is an unofficial patched app, not an endorsed Reddit release.

versions.localizedDescription: Revived Apollo with configurable Reddit API key — bring your own credentials.

apps.name: Cowabunga
apps.subtitle: iOS 14-16.1.2 MacDirtyCow toolbox — themes, tweaks, no jailbreak
apps.localizedDescription: Cowabunga is an iOS customization toolbox for specific older iOS versions that were vulnerable to the MacDirtyCow technique. On supported devices it can apply selected interface customizations such as icons, themes, status-bar appearance, dock and folder changes without a traditional jailbreak. These modifications rely on narrow OS/device vulnerability ranges and are not expected to work on current unsupported releases. Check the exact iOS build and back up important data before applying changes.

versions.localizedDescription: MacDirtyCow toolbox for iOS 14-16.1.2 — theming & system tweaks without jailbreak.

apps.name: Misaka
apps.subtitle: iOS & tvOS customisation for KFD & MDC — successor to Cowabunga
apps.localizedDescription: Misaka is an iOS and tvOS customization utility associated with the KFD and MacDirtyCow exploit families. On compatible OS/device combinations it exposes supported tweaks and visual customizations, with the available options depending on which exploit applies to that system version. It is not a universal theming tool: newer iOS releases may close the required vulnerabilities, and individual tweaks can be device-specific. Verify compatibility before applying system changes.

versions.localizedDescription: KFD & MDC customisation tool — themes, tweaks for iOS/tvOS.

apps.name: Paperback
apps.subtitle: Manga reader — extensions, tracking & downloads
apps.localizedDescription: Paperback is a SwiftUI manga and comic reader for iOS that uses an extension-based source system. Install compatible extensions to browse series, search catalogs, follow titles in a library, track reading progress where supported, download chapters for offline reading, and customize reader behavior. The app itself does not guarantee that any particular source will remain online; extensions are separately maintained and may need updates when provider sites change.

versions.localizedDescription: Manga reader with extensions — track, download and read offline.

apps.name: DebToIPA
apps.subtitle: Convert .deb tweaks to .ipa on-device (SwiftUI)
apps.localizedDescription: DebToIPA is an on-device conversion utility for working with Debian-style .deb packages and producing an IPA package where the package contents and conversion method are compatible. It is aimed at users adapting certain jailbreak tweak packages for inspection or use in a sideloading workflow, without moving the conversion to a computer. Conversion does not automatically make a jailbreak-only tweak compatible with stock iOS, and the resulting package may still need additional dependencies, injection, signing, or a supported runtime.

versions.localizedDescription: Convert .deb to .ipa on-device — tweak installer helper.

apps.name: ModMyIPA
apps.subtitle: Duplicate any IPA — install multiple copies side-by-side
apps.localizedDescription: ModMyIPA modifies an IPA package's bundle identifier so separate copies of an app can be installed side by side when their signing and app behavior permit it. This can help isolate test builds, keep separate app instances, or compare a modified build with an original. Changing the bundle ID does not guarantee that an app's internal URL schemes, keychain groups, push notifications, shared containers, or account behavior will remain independent; those may still be tied to the original identifier or entitlements.

versions.localizedDescription: Modify IPA bundle ID to install duplicates of any app.

apps.name: Azula
apps.subtitle: Inject dylibs into IPAs on-device (SwiftUI + ElleKit)
apps.localizedDescription: Azula is an on-device IPA modification utility for injecting compatible dynamic libraries (dylibs) into an app bundle. It is designed for tweak-development and app-patching workflows where a library needs to be inserted and the resulting package rebuilt for signing. Injection is not equivalent to installing a tweak system-wide: the library must be compatible with the target app, architecture, OS, and available injection/runtime method, and the modified IPA generally needs to be signed again. Supported OS versions differ by feature.

versions.localizedDescription: Inject dylibs into IPAs on-device — tweak patcher.

apps.name: AppDB
apps.subtitle: Full client for appdb.to — sideloaded apps database
apps.localizedDescription: AppDB is a third-party iOS client for the appdb.to app catalog and management service. It provides a mobile interface for browsing app listings, searching the catalog, managing supported stores or sources, and initiating supported app installation workflows. Available content, signing methods, and installation access depend on appdb.to's service and account configuration. It is not an Apple or App Store service; verify the provenance and safety of any package before installing it.

versions.localizedDescription: Full-featured appdb.to client — browse and install cracked IPAs.

apps.name: Mirarr
apps.subtitle: FOSS movie & TV app — watch movies and TV shows
apps.localizedDescription: Mirarr is a free, open-source, cross-platform media application built with Flutter. Its interface is intended for discovering and playing movie and television content through the sources and integrations supported by the project. The IPA listed here is an unsigned upstream release that must be signed before normal sideload installation. Content availability depends on configured sources and services; the app listing does not itself supply or license copyrighted video.

versions.localizedDescription: Official Mirarr v3.3.2 Release IPA (unsigned, Sidestore-signable). See release notes on GitHub.

apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins, passcode themes and wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription: AirCard-iOS is an on-device customization utility for supported iOS 27+ builds. It is designed to change compatible Apple Wallet card artwork, lock-screen passcode dialer appearance, and PosterBoard wallpaper assets without a traditional jailbreak. It relies on Developer Mode pairing and LocalDevVPN in loopback mode, and its system-level operations depend on specific OS behavior; it will not work on unsupported iOS versions or devices.

apps.name: AniBaka
apps.subtitle: 跨平台番剧聚合、媒体播放与弹幕客户端
apps.localizedDescription: AniBaka 是一个基于 Flutter 的跨平台番剧聚合与媒体播放客户端，支持多番剧源、弹幕、字幕、离线缓存与本地媒体库，并提供动漫实时超分辨率画质增强。

apps.name: AnimeFlow
apps.subtitle: 跨平台动漫视频播放器，支持多数据源、实时 4K 超分辨率与弹幕
apps.localizedDescription: AnimeFlow 是一个跨平台动漫视频播放应用，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 与 Linux。内置多数据源与自定义 XPath 爬虫配置，支持基于 Anime4K 的实时视频 4K 超分辨率，对接 Bangumi 同步收藏与追番数据，并支持多平台弹幕源与丰富的弹幕设置。

apps.name: Animeko
apps.subtitle: 一站式弹幕追番平台
apps.localizedDescription: Animeko 是一个 Kotlin/Compose Multiplatform 打造的一站式弹幕追番平台，集找番、追番、看番于一体，支持 Bangumi 云同步观看记录、多视频数据源聚合（含 BitTorrent、Jellyfin、Emby）、离线缓存与弹幕云过滤。

apps.name: ARMSX2
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: ARMSX2 is an open-source PlayStation 2 emulator based on PCSX2 and aimed at ARM64 devices. It uses native ARM64 just-in-time recompilers to translate supported PS2 instructions for execution on the host device, and is intended to run compatible game images with emulator configuration and save management. Actual compatibility and speed depend on the title, device, graphics backend, and JIT availability. It does not include commercial games or BIOS files.

apps.name: BCD
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: BCD is a Windows-game launcher/runtime for iPhone and iPad. It combines a game library and supported Steam/GOG workflows with Wine for Windows compatibility, FEX for x86 instruction translation, and DXMT/Metal graphics translation for supported DirectX games. Games run locally rather than being streamed from a PC, but only compatible titles will work and performance depends on the game, device, OS build, JIT availability, storage, and graphics features. Bring your own legally obtained game files and accounts.

apps.name: Doer
apps.subtitle: A native iOS client for Linux.do
apps.localizedDescription: Doer is a native iOS client for the Linux.do online community. It provides an iPhone-oriented interface for accessing community discussions and account features supported by Linux.do, rather than requiring the site's desktop layout in a browser. It is a client for that external service, so sign-in, available functions, and continued compatibility depend on Linux.do's current APIs and policies.

apps.name: DolphiniOS
apps.subtitle: GameCube and Wii emulator for iOS/iPadOS
apps.localizedDescription: DolphiniOS is an iOS/iPadOS port of the Dolphin emulator for Nintendo GameCube and Wii software. It is intended to load compatible game images, render supported titles, manage game-specific settings and saves, and use touch or compatible controller input. Performance and compatibility vary widely by title and device, and accelerated execution may require a suitable JIT setup. It does not include commercial game files, and some games require system data supplied by the user.

apps.name: DukeX
apps.subtitle: Original Xbox emulation for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: DukeX is an experimental native iOS frontend for the xemu original-Xbox emulator. It wraps the xemu emulation core in a Swift interface and routes the graphics renderer through MoltenVK and Apple's Metal graphics stack. It is intended for testing original Xbox software on supported iPhone/iPad hardware, but remains experimental: performance, boot success, controller support, firmware requirements, and game compatibility can vary. Required Xbox firmware and game data must be supplied legally by the user.

apps.name: EhPanda
apps.subtitle: An unofficial E-Hentai App for iOS built with SwiftUI & TCA
apps.localizedDescription: EhPanda is an unofficial E-Hentai app for iOS & iPadOS built with SwiftUI & TCA. It supports almost all E-Hentai gallery categories, gallery browsing with filters, gallery details with tags & related galleries, posting / editing / replying to comments, H@H archiving, torrent listing, E-Hentai settings, and SNI-bypass (domain fronting) for restricted networks. Localization is built in and the app icon and accent color are customizable.

apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: x86-64 PC emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Fathom is an experimental x86-64 Linux executable runner for iOS/iPadOS. It uses FEXCore to translate x86-64 instructions to ARM64, maps the program into a guest address space, and translates supported Linux system calls so the program can run locally. Current builds are deliberately limited: they support statically linked position-independent executables (static PIE), run the guest single-threaded, and do not support dynamically linked binaries or 32-bit x86. JIT/debugger attachment is required for execution.

apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Husk is an experimental Android-app runtime for iOS that accepts a user-provided APK and launches it inside a QEMU-based Android guest presented as a full-screen app. It aims to provide guest display and audio rather than translating the APK into a native iOS app. Runtime execution depends on JIT and a debugger attached to the process, so the signing setup must preserve the required debugging entitlement (get-task-allow); an ordinary re-sign may not be sufficient. Android app compatibility and speed vary, and APKs are not included.

apps.name: Iridium
apps.subtitle: Experimental Windows-game runtime for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Iridium is an experimental local Windows-game runtime for iPhone and iPad. It provides a native library for importing and launching user-owned game files, with touch controls and support for compatible keyboards, mice, and controllers. Games execute on the device rather than being streamed from a PC, but the runtime is early-stage and compatibility is title-specific. It requires iOS 18 or later and JIT; bring your own legally obtained game files.

apps.name: Kazumi
apps.subtitle: 基于自定义规则的番剧采集APP，支持流媒体在线观看，支持弹幕，支持实时超分辨率。
apps.localizedDescription: Kazumi 是一款基于 Flutter 的规则驱动型番剧采集与在线播放应用。用户可用 XPath 选择器编写、导入和分享视频源规则，再通过多个数据源搜索番剧、浏览剧集并在线播放；应用还提供弹幕显示、追番列表、播放历史、倍速控制、主题配色，以及基于 Anime4K 的实时超分辨率功能。实际片源取决于用户配置的规则与第三方站点，规则可能随网站改版而失效。

apps.name: KMusic
apps.subtitle: 基于 SwiftUI 的多源音乐聚合播放器
apps.localizedDescription: KMusic 是一款面向 iOS 和 macOS 的 SwiftUI 多音源音乐播放器。它聚合多个音乐服务的可用音源，提供全局搜索、歌曲播放、LRC 歌词同步、后台播放和深色主题，并允许用户通过 JavaScript 脚本导入自定义音源。音源的可用性与播放权限取决于各提供方的接口和服务变化；它并非这些音乐平台的官方客户端。

apps.name: Kumone
apps.subtitle: 原生 NetEase Cloud Music iOS 客户端（雲の音）
apps.localizedDescription: Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management. Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Madeira runs unmodified x86-64 Windows PC games inside a single jailed iOS app: FEX-Emu translates the game's x86 code to ARM64 as it runs, Wine 11.4 built for ARM64EC provides Windows itself, and DXMT plus Madeira's own Direct3D 12 runtime draw Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12 through Metal. Games come with a library, Steam sign-in and installs, controller and touch controls, and keyboard, mouse and trackpad input. Requires an iPhone on iOS 26 or later with JIT enabled through StikDebug.

apps.name: Mangayomi
apps.subtitle: Read manga, novels, and watch anime
apps.localizedDescription: Mangayomi is an open-source Flutter media reader for manga, novels, and anime. It brings supported online catalog sources into a single interface for searching titles, browsing chapters or episodes, reading manga and novels, and playing supported video content. Source availability depends on configured providers and their extensions or rules; the app does not guarantee that third-party sources will remain available. Check the project's platform and source compatibility before relying on a particular provider.

apps.name: ManicEMU
apps.subtitle: All-in-one retro game emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: ManicEMU is an all-in-one retro emulation frontend for iOS that groups supported console, arcade, computer, and Java-based mobile systems in one library. Depending on the included cores, it can launch compatible game/software images and provide common emulator features such as save states, cheats, configurable skins, and RetroAchievements integration. Compatibility differs by system and core, and game files or firmware are not bundled.

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

apps.name: MoviePilotLite
apps.subtitle: MoviePilot 移动端，基于 Flutter 实现
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 MoviePilot 的 Flutter 跨端客户端，对接 MoviePilot v2 API，在手机上完成订阅、搜索、下载、整理与系统运维等常用操作。

apps.name: Musly
apps.subtitle: Free Navidrome client & Subsonic music player
apps.localizedDescription: Musly is a music player for personal libraries hosted on Navidrome, Subsonic, or compatible Airsonic servers. Connect it to a server you control, browse artists, albums and tracks, stream audio, and use its Apple Music-inspired interface to manage playback across supported devices. The app is a client, not a music-hosting service: you need a working server and your own library, and features depend on the server API and network connection.

apps.name: Novella
apps.subtitle: 轻书架第三方客户端
apps.localizedDescription: Novella 是一款使用 React Native 构建、面向 iPhone 与 iPad 的轻书架第三方客户端。它为轻书架服务提供移动端浏览与阅读入口，便于用户在设备上访问自己的书架内容；实际可用的书库、登录方式、阅读能力和同步行为取决于所连接的服务及当前客户端版本。它不是官方服务本身，也不会自动提供书籍资源。

apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription: Opaline is a lightweight third-party YouTube client for older and newer supported iOS devices. It focuses on video playback and includes SponsorBlock integration for skipping supported sponsor segments, Return YouTube Dislike information where available, and playback up to 1080p when the source and device allow it. It is not an official YouTube app, and features may change as YouTube's site, APIs, or playback systems change.

apps.name: Orchard
apps.subtitle: Apple Silicon macOS Ventura running inside an iPhone app
apps.localizedDescription: Boots a real arm64 macOS Ventura guest on iPhone through Apple's own chain (AVPBooter, iBoot and XNU) on QEMU's apple-vm machine, with the GPU drawn through Metal by reims-vgpu. Requires JIT, a signing tool that adds the increased memory limit, and a macOS VM you make yourself. It is slow — light scenes reach 30–40 fps at best.

apps.name: PiliPlus
apps.subtitle: 使用Flutter开发的BiliBili第三方客户端
apps.localizedDescription: PiliPlus 是一款基于 Flutter 的非官方哔哩哔哩（Bilibili）客户端，面向移动设备提供视频内容浏览与播放入口。它用于访问服务支持的推荐、搜索、视频详情及相关社区内容；具体功能、登录能力和播放兼容性取决于当前版本及 Bilibili 接口变化。它并非 Bilibili 官方应用，也不自带平台视频内容。

apps.name: Pixiv-SwiftUI
apps.subtitle: 基于 SwiftUI 的 Pixiv 第三方客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 SwiftUI 开发的 Pixiv 第三方客户端，支持 iOS/iPadOS/macOS。提供插画、漫画与小说的推荐、排行榜、搜索与收藏，内置评论系统、批量下载、数据导入导出、深色模式与主题自定义。

apps.name: Playport
apps.subtitle: PC games on your iPhone. Natively, no streaming.
apps.localizedDescription: Playport runs Windows games, 64-bit and 32-bit, on a stock, non-jailbroken iPhone: install a game from your library onto the phone, pick up a controller and press Play. The game runs on the phone's own CPU and GPU — no PC, no cloud, no stream. Requires iOS 26 or later with JIT enabled through LocalDevVPN or StikDebug.

apps.name: PSX3IOS
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 3 emulator for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A PlayStation 3 emulator for iPhone and iPad, built on RPCS3. Real games boot and play — the whole emulator core is exposed, with community game patches, trophies, play time, save data and 14 languages. Works with or without JIT.

apps.name: Roam Control
apps.subtitle: Choose, test and move your iPhone's reported location
apps.localizedDescription: Set a fixed reported location, preview and simulate Apple Maps walking routes, and save favourites and history — all from one map. Requires iOS 27 or newer, and guided LocalDevVPN-compatible sessions for Wi-Fi and mobile data.

apps.name: SceneBox
apps.subtitle: Torrent streaming client
apps.localizedDescription: Torrent streaming client for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS and Mac (Catalyst), written in SwiftUI. Streams come from Stremio-compatible addons and play through a vendored libtorrent engine feeding VLC.

apps.name: SpotiFLAC
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC is a Flutter music app built around installable extensions: an extension supplies the metadata and the audio downloads for one provider, so sources can be added or repaired without an app update. Downloads land in a local library with lyrics, cover art, quality badges and duplicate detection.

apps.name: TiebaPure
apps.subtitle: 基于 SwiftUI 的第三方百度贴吧客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 原生 SwiftUI 构建的非官方贴吧 iOS 客户端。未登录访客即可浏览首页推荐、进吧与吧内列表、帖子详情与楼中楼、搜索、图片缩放与视频播放；登录后支持消息、关注与粉丝、收藏帖子（与官方客户端同步）、每日签到、点赞与发帖回复。另有关键词/用户/贴吧屏蔽、浏览历史与阅读位置恢复、iPad 双栏布局，以及 `tiebapure://` 深链接。

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.subtitle: Native manga & manhwa reader for Suwayomi-Server
apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

apps.name: VeneraNext
apps.subtitle: 跨平台漫画阅读器
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 Flutter 的跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源与第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

apps.name: ZhihuMinusMinus
apps.subtitle: 轻量、纯净的第三方知乎客户端
apps.localizedDescription: 基于 React Native (Expo) 构建的轻量级第三方知乎客户端，无广告，支持多账号切换、游客模式、全局主题色自定义与深色模式，可查看热榜、推荐、回答、文章、想法与评论区，并支持从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

apps.name: Empo
apps.subtitle: Run RPG Maker and PSDK games on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Empo is a native SwiftUI game library with customizable touch controls. It runs RPG Maker XP, VX, and VX Ace games, modern Pokemon Essentials forks, and PSDK games on the device, with no desktop emulator. Features: - Plays games made for RGSS1 (XP), RGSS2 (VX), RGSS3 (VX Ace), modern mkxp-z forks, and PSDK - Picks the right engine and Ruby version (1.8, 1.9, 3.0, 3.1) for each game - Imports games from folders, .zip, .7z, .rar, and JoiPlay's .jgp format - Customizable on-screen D-pad and action buttons, with per-game layouts - Pause and resume from the library with a hero zoom transition - Library with sort, search, grid/list views, and bulk delete

apps.name: Artemis
apps.subtitle: Alternative client for HIDIVE
apps.localizedDescription: Artemis is an open-source alternative client for the HIDIVE anime-streaming service. It provides a separate interface for browsing and watching content available to a compatible HIDIVE account, subject to the service's catalog, subscription, region, and authentication rules. It is not an official HIDIVE app, does not grant a subscription, and may need updates when the service changes its APIs or playback system.

apps.name: AnymeX
apps.subtitle: Multiservice tracking client
apps.localizedDescription: AnymeX is an anime discovery and watch-tracking client that connects with services including AniList, MyAnimeList, and Simkl. Use supported integrations to organize a watch list, record progress, and keep anime activity associated with the services you use. The app is a tracker/client rather than a source of licensed video; available synchronization and account features depend on each service's API and permissions.

apps.name: Winston for Reddit
apps.subtitle: Winston, a beautiful and native Reddit client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Winston is an in-development, open-source native Reddit client for iOS. It is designed to provide a mobile interface for browsing Reddit communities, posts, comments, and account activity, with an emphasis on a native navigation experience. Because it remains under development, features and stability can change between builds; access depends on Reddit authentication, API availability, and the current service rules. It is not an official Reddit app.

apps.name: VortX
apps.subtitle: Stream movies and shows on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: VortX is a native, open-source streaming app for Apple devices, built on the official stremio-core engine and the libmpv player. Multi-profile, HDR and Dolby Vision, skip intro and outro, stream ranking, in-app add-ons and debrid keys, and more. Sideload-friendly: this source delivers one-tap updates so you never re-download an IPA by hand.

apps.name: VortX (Apple TV)
apps.subtitle: Stream movies and shows on Apple TV.
apps.localizedDescription: VortX for Apple TV: a native, open-source streaming app on the official stremio-core engine and the libmpv player, with an in-process streaming server for torrents. HDR and Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos passthrough, stream ranking, in-app add-ons and debrid keys, Top Shelf, and more. This source delivers one-tap updates so you never sideload an IPA by hand.

apps.name: Flycast
apps.subtitle: Dreamcast, Naomi and Atomiswave emulator.
apps.localizedDescription: Flycast is an open-source emulator for Sega Dreamcast, Naomi, Naomi 2, and Atomiswave systems. It loads compatible game images and aims to reproduce the original hardware in software, with configurable video and input settings and support for the features available in the selected build. Performance and compatibility depend on the game, device, and iOS version. This IPA is an iOS 26-compatible community fork; consult its upstream release notes for known limitations. Game files and required firmware are not bundled.

versions.localizedDescription: iOS 26-compatible community fork; see upstream release notes for device compatibility.

apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media-library app for phones, computers, and supported TV platforms. Rather than supplying a fixed catalog, it lets users connect their own compatible content sources and organizes available titles into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and playback-position tracking across supported screens. Source setup and cross-device continuity depend on the integrations and services you configure; the app does not itself license or include copyrighted media.

apps.name: Reynard
apps.subtitle: Gecko-based browser, a real WebKit alternative
apps.localizedDescription: Reynard is an experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13 and newer. Unlike standard iOS browsers that use Apple's WebKit engine, it aims to render pages with Gecko, the engine used by Firefox, and distributes builds through its own GitHub releases. It is a research/experimental project, so site compatibility, extensions, performance, and stability may be limited and can change between releases.

apps.name: Geode
apps.subtitle: Geometry Dash mod loader and launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Geode is a mod loader for Geometry Dash, and this entry is its iOS launcher. It helps launch a compatible installation of the full Geometry Dash game with supported mods and provides the associated mod-loading workflow. Geometry Dash must be installed separately, and an internet connection is needed for relevant online features or mod retrieval. Mods and game data are not bundled here; compatibility depends on the Geometry Dash version, iOS version, and the individual mod.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes for iOS 27 compatibility, JIT-less mod importing, safe mode and helper updates.

apps.name: EscapeOS
apps.subtitle: App-data browser, backup and restore
apps.localizedDescription: EscapeOS is an on-device file browser and app-data backup/restore tool for sideloaded iOS. It can browse supported app data containers, edit and extract archives, create ZIP backups with SHA-256 manifests, and restore data. Requires LocalDevVPN and a pairing file for app listing. Important: cross-app container access depends on the bad_query exploit and is only supported on iOS 26.0–26.6.1 and iOS 27.0 beta 4; later versions are unsupported. Minimum install version is iOS 18.0.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds ongoing improvements to the app-data browser, backup/restore, archive handling, and file operations. See upstream compatibility notes before relying on cross-app container access.

apps.name: iDevice Toolkit
apps.subtitle: iOS customization and IPA utility toolkit
apps.localizedDescription: iDevice Toolkit provides iOS customization features, a file manager, and IPA tweak-injection tools on supported system versions. The developer explicitly states that it does not work inside LiveContainer and must be installed as a normal sideload. Built-in system tweaks are limited to specific iOS releases; file-manager and IPA-injection features have separate compatibility bounds. Review the official release notes before use.

versions.localizedDescription: Official v2.0.1 IPA release. Supports selected system tweaks on iOS 16.0–18.3.2; file manager and IPA tweak injection support have different limits, including iOS 26 for selected functions. Not compatible with LiveContainer.

apps.name: AltStore Classic
apps.subtitle: Open-source iOS app sideloading manager
apps.localizedDescription: AltStore Classic is an open-source sideloading app for installing and refreshing apps signed with a personal Apple developer account. It supports AltStore sources and works alongside a computer-hosted AltServer workflow. This is the classic sideloading build, not AltStore PAL. It overlaps with SideStore, so most users only need one signing workflow.

versions.localizedDescription: Official AltStore Classic v2.3 notarized IPA release.

apps.name: PokeMMO
apps.subtitle: Free-to-play cross-platform monster-catching MMO
apps.localizedDescription: PokeMMO is a persistent online multiplayer game for iOS, PC, Mac, Linux, and Android. It supports cross-platform play and requires an account and an internet connection. The game does not bundle copyrighted game ROMs; players must supply game files they have the legal right to use. The official iOS source provides this IPA directly.

versions.localizedDescription: Official PokeMMO iOS build 32920. Requires an account, persistent internet access, and user-supplied compatible game files.
